![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

This datamining contains items that can be released in the Atom Shop in the next live patches. Also in the mid-season patch, which must be released by April 21, 2026 at the latest (so that the Rip Daring Mini Season can go live).
